name: popsicle
headline: Facebook Auto Poster - Post to Multiple Groups
short_description: Auto-poster for Facebook groups, allowing you to publish posts to multiple groups simultaneously. Perfect for marketers, community managers, and anyone looking to engage with a wide audience efficiently
author: Tigerzplace

sections.overview:
FAP-FacebookAutoPoster is a marketing automation tool that enables simultaneous posting to multiple Facebook groups. Developed by Tigerzplace, it streamlines content distribution for users managing multiple communities. The skill is designed for marketers, community managers, and group administrators who need to reach broad audiences without manual cross-posting. It reduces the time required to maintain consistent presence across multiple Facebook groups.
Community managers maintaining engagement across multiple Facebook groups simultaneously
Marketers distributing promotional content to relevant audience segments at scale
Small business owners posting updates to multiple customer or interest-based groups
Content creators sharing material across multiple niche communities
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Tigerzplace/FAP-FacebookAutoPoster`
sections.usage:
```
Post the following content to these Facebook groups: [GROUP_NAMES]. The content is: [CONTENT]. Ensure the post adheres to each group's rules and guidelines. Schedule the posts for [TIME] if needed.
```
Copy

```
Post successfully scheduled to the following Facebook groups: 'Digital Marketing Professionals', 'Small Business Owners Network', and 'Entrepreneurs Hub'. The content 'Join our webinar on advanced Facebook advertising strategies this Thursday at 2 PM EST. Limited seats available! Register now: [LINK]' has been posted with the scheduled time set for 8 AM EST tomorrow. Each post includes a friendly introduction tailored to the group's specific focus.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
